tutorialPages.messageText: NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "AF65A6144F29093256B7489C0F2EF02D", "Crates can only be stored in a Warehouse and must be transported by vehicle or on player\'s backs. There are Commodities, sold by vendors, or Construction and Personal Crates that are packed by players.")

NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "B7FC52C1403193058E7AEF862EE82A03", "Empty crates can be purchased at any caravansary and packed with materials to transport to other Settlements. Construction Crates are packed at Construction Stations and turned in at active Settlement construction sites.")

NSLOCTEXT("[FEA8EFE747B6BFEF48AD2AB3CBEF2B13]", "2B91714D4AEC4482E23015A9FE45D0DA", "Warehouse staff will unpack sealed Personal Crates for you when you\'re ready. However, the items must be inspected, so it may be some time before your items are available to retrieve.")
